title: Kinetic vs Potential Energy
hook: Potential is stored. Kinetic is motion.
narration: Potential is stored. Kinetic is motion.
Today's question: Kinetic vs Potential Energy.
A held ball has potential. A falling ball spends it as kinetic.
Hold the cause in your head, then the effect.
Energy changes form. The total in a closed system stays put.
This is the part most people skip. Do not skip it.
That bookkeeping is conservation of energy.
If you can say why kinetic vs potential energy works, you understood the film.
No gore. Just the model. School-safe.
The pictures today are a new ball world. Not yesterday's film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for kinetic vs potential energy.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
